I wrote `open.csv` in the working directory with 9 open invoices.

```
invoice,outstanding
INV-0002,455.04
INV-0005,711.30
INV-0006,41.64
INV-0008,437.66
INV-0009,479.11
INV-0011,120.70
INV-0017,701.73
INV-0018,459.69
INV-0020,297.97
```

Bash is disabled in this session, so I could not run a script. I worked the amounts out by hand from the two CSVs and wrote the file directly. I checked each invoice against its payments, but nothing was executed.

How the payments were applied:
- **INV-0002:** 195.02 paid, so 455.04 is outstanding.
- **INV-0011:** the 999.00 payment referencing "INV-0004 en INV-0011" pays INV-0004 in full (329.69). The remaining 669.31 goes to INV-0011, leaving 120.70.
- **INV-0022:** 277.04 paid against 272.04. The 5.00 overpayment is not carried anywhere, so the invoice is closed.
- **Multi-payment invoices:** INV-0013, INV-0014, INV-0015 and INV-0023 each get two payments that sum to the invoice amount, so they are closed.
- **Ignored payments:** the two "overschrijving zonder referentie" rows (437.66 and 297.97) have no invoice number. The 120.00 payment referencing INV-0098 is ignored because that invoice does not exist. INV-0008 and INV-0020 therefore have no payments and are listed at their full amounts.
